"Inspect actual adopted inputs and assemble a self-review with explicit independent inheritance."

import argparse
import json
import runpy
import shlex
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

from common import (
    AUDIT,
    BASE,
    DOSSIER,
    ORIGINAL_SCIENCE,
    PACKAGE,
    PAGE,
    ROOT,
    SCIENCE,
    TARGET,
    TARGET_ID,
    TARGET_SHA,
    bind,
    external_new,
    inventory,
    now,
    read,
    run,
    sha,
    write,
)

RUBRICS = [
    "schema/record_review.yaml",
    "scripts/record_review.py",
    "docs/record-reviews.md",
    "docs/record-review-profile.md",
    "conf/record_review.yaml",
    ".claude/skills/review-yaml-record/SKILL.md",
    ".claude/skills/add-pathway/SKILL.md",
    "CLAUDE.md",
    "justfile",
    "docs/CURATION.md",
    "docs/HARMONIZATION.md",
    "docs/CAUSAL_GRAPHS.md",
    "history/README.md",
    "scripts/new_history_record.py",
    "src/pathwaymech/schema/history.yaml",
    "src/pathwaymech/schema.py",
    "src/pathwaymech/schema/pathwaymech.yaml",
    "src/pathwaymech/strict.py",
    "conf/identifier_policy.yaml",
    "src/pathwaymech/kgx.py",
    "src/pathwaymech/graph_view.py",
]


def dump_review(review):
    """Use the unchanged native saver's alias-free review serialization."""
    native = runpy.run_path(
        str(ROOT / "scripts/record_review.py"), run_name="lyxose_native_review_serialization"
    )
    return native["_dump_document"](review)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--archive-receipt", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    from lineage import verify_archive_receipt

    archive, plan, cfg, adoption, gates, preservation, acceptance, tested = verify_archive_receipt(
        args.archive_receipt
    )
    output = external_new(args.output)
    output.mkdir()
    inputs = (
        set(RUBRICS)
        | set(tested)
        | {PAGE, "pages/downloads/nodes.tsv", "pages/downloads/edges.tsv"}
    )
    inputs.update(str(Path(DOSSIER) / p) for p in inventory(ROOT / DOSSIER))
    write(output / "native-inspection-inputs.json", sorted(inputs - {TARGET}))
    command = [
        str(PACKAGE / "inspect_with_inputs.py"),
        "--input-list",
        str(output / "native-inspection-inputs.json"),
        "--targets",
        str(PACKAGE / "targets.yaml"),
    ]
    inspection = json.loads(run("inspect", command, output))
    assert inspection["source"]["git_revision"] == BASE
    started = read(output / "inspect-execution.json")["started_at"]
    # Inspection precedes this current-byte assessment. No stale-input refresh.
    doc = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / TARGET).read_bytes())
    assert sha(ROOT / TARGET) == TARGET_SHA
    edges, refs = doc["mechanistic_edges"], doc["references"]
    assert len(edges) == 111 and len(refs) == 66
    assert sum(len(x.get("endpoint_qualifiers", [])) for x in edges) == 10
    science = read(SCIENCE / "review.json")
    assert science["verdict"] == "accepted" and science["findings"] == []
    assert science["target"]["sha256"] == TARGET_SHA
    edge_prior = {x["edge_id"]: x for x in read(ORIGINAL_SCIENCE / "edge-assessments.json")}
    assert len(edge_prior) == 109
    evidence, assessments, checks = [], [], []
    timestamp = now()

    def ev(eid, path, summary, kind="validation", locator=None):
        path = Path(path)
        x = {
            "evidence_id": eid,
            "kind": kind,
            "reference": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) if path.is_relative_to(ROOT) else str(path),
            "accessed_at": timestamp,
            "support": "supports",
            "summary": summary,
            "snapshot_sha256": sha(path),
        }
        if locator:
            x["locator"] = locator
        evidence.append(x)

    ev(
        "target",
        ROOT / TARGET,
        "Exact adopted accepted target; all 111 edges and 66 reference objects parsed.",
        "record_content",
    )
    ev(
        "original-science",
        ORIGINAL_SCIENCE / "review.json",
        "Independent original scientist inspected all 109 origina"
        "l edges and 64 references; two scoped omissions led to i"
        "ssues 438/439. Inherited rather than represented as a ne"
        "w author-independent review.",
        "prior_review",
    )
    ev(
        "edge-science",
        ORIGINAL_SCIENCE / "edge-assessments.json",
        "Exact original scientist per-edge assessments inherited "
        "only through the accepted successor equality proof.",
        "prior_review",
    )
    ev(
        "successor-science",
        SCIENCE / "review.json",
        "Independent successor accepted the exact target: 109 unc"
        "hanged edges and original references proven; 14 new regu"
        "latory evidence uses and two pectin-context uses freshly"
        " reassessed; 17 controls. All 66 originals hashed.",
        "prior_review",
    )
    ev(
        "canonical-audit",
        AUDIT / "review.json",
        "Independent complete canonical audit accepted 2412 sourc"
        "e terms/563 metadata, 1945 ontology terms/5 metadata, al"
        "l old objects preserved, 42 additions replayed and typed"
        " native provenance controls.",
        "prior_review",
    )
    for key in [
        "gates",
        "preservation",
        "tested_inputs",
        "page_qa",
        "visual_observation",
        "root_assessment",
    ]:
        ev(
            key.replace("_", "-"),
            cfg[key]["path"],
            {
                "gates": acceptance["gate_summary"],
                "preservation": "Actual exact preservation of 227 prior records/pages and"
                " 101 saved review bundles, history, old edge cells and s"
                "ource contexts; no blanket node display waiver.",
                "tested_inputs": "Exact supplied bindings rehashed after actual gates; tem"
                "poral scope remains as recorded in the original receipt.",
                "page_qa": "Root original graph/anchor QA; coverage and page bytes s"
                "eparately bound by root assessment.",
                "visual_observation": acceptance["visual_summary"],
                "root_assessment": "Actual root acceptance, original receipt hashes and decl"
                "ared limitations, not inferred tool success.",
            }[key],
        )
    if preservation["node_display_delta"]:
        for key in ["display_approval", "display_assessment"]:
            ev(
                key.replace("_", "-"),
                cfg[key]["path"],
                "Exact source-backed shared-node display tuple assessment"
                " and approval; no other cells waived.",
            )
    for row in gates["receipts"]:
        checks.append(
            {
                "check_id": "maintained-" + row["name"],
                "name": "Actual maintained " + row["name"],
                "status": "passed",
                "required": True,
                "summary": "Root-executed gate passed; exact command, logs, start/en"
                "d and environment are retained. "
                + (
                    acceptance["gate_summary"]
                    if row["name"] == "tests"
                    else "See the bound original log for complete output."
                ),
                "target_ids": [TARGET_ID],
                "command": shlex.join(row["command"]),
                "exit_code": row["exit_code"],
                "evidence_ids": ["gates"],
                "scope_note": "Actual full maintained gate inherited from its inspected"
                " receipt; not rerun by this preparer.",
            }
        )
    checks.append(
        {
            "check_id": "preservation",
            "name": "Exact maintained baseline preservation",
            "status": "passed",
            "required": True,
            "summary": "227 prior records/pages, 101 review bundles, history and"
            " old KGX cells/contexts retained. Exact display approval"
            " required for every changed old display cell.",
            "target_ids": [TARGET_ID],
            "evidence_ids": ["preservation", "root-assessment"],
        }
    )
    for edge in edges:
        eid = edge["id"]
        inherited = edge_prior.get(eid)
        if inherited:
            detail = json.dumps(inherited, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
            eids = ["target", "edge-science", "successor-science"]
            summary = (
                "Independent original edge assessment inherited through t"
                "he accepted exact-object successor proof: "
                + inherited["category"]
                + ". All recorded source, strain, assay, chemical and const"
                "ruct limits remain applicable."
            )
        else:
            assert eid in {"lyxose-110", "lyxose-111"}
            eids = ["target", "successor-science"]
            detail = json.dumps(
                science["prior_finding_dispositions"][0],
                ensure_ascii=False,
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            summary = (
                "Independent successor accepted this source-qualified rec"
                "iprocal negative regulator-to-gene expression edge. Dele"
                "tion/Northern evidence permits indirect regulation; no p"
                "romoter binding or wild-type complete flux is inferred."
            )
        assessments.append(
            {
                "assessment_id": "edge-" + eid,
                "area": "evidence",
                "topic": "mechanistic_edges[id=" + eid + "]",
                "outcome": "supported",
                "summary": summary,
                "details": detail,
                "target_ids": [TARGET_ID],
                "evidence_ids": eids,
                "dimensions": [
                    {
                        "name": "inheritance",
                        "value": "exact independent accepted predecessor scope",
                        "definition": "This author-prepared review packages independent finding"
                        "s; it is not a new independent source assessment.",
                        "evidence_ids": eids,
                    }
                ],
            }
        )
    for finding in science["prior_finding_dispositions"]:
        assessments.append(
            {
                "assessment_id": "external-issue-" + str(finding["issue"]),
                "area": "completeness",
                "topic": finding["stable_issue_key"],
                "outcome": "supported",
                "summary": "Independent source-backed correction accepted in exact t"
                "arget. External issue "
                + str(finding["issue"])
                + " remains a GitHub lifecycle item until root verifies mer"
                "ge. This is not fabricated native previous_occurrences.",
                "details": json.dumps(finding, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
                "target_ids": [TARGET_ID],
                "evidence_ids": ["original-science", "successor-science", "target"],
            }
        )
    for aid, area, topic, summary, eids in [
        (
            "identity",
            "identity",
            "Exact complete pathway identity and authority",
            "Four core events and all native chemical sides, RhaT ent"
            "ry, source-defined assemblies and downstream opaque inte"
            "rfaces remain exact. Generic and beta anomers are not co"
            "llapsed. Typed Compound class and frozen ZIP member prov"
            "enance were independently reviewed.",
            ["target", "successor-science", "canonical-audit"],
        ),
        (
            "scope",
            "scope",
            "Experimental and annotation limits",
            "1991 mutant1P remains distinct from adapted JA1345P. Sgb"
            "U is tentative with two negative assays; PathBank UlaF c"
            "onflict is retained. Assay metals, modified states, cons"
            "tructs and regulation are bounded. No ordinary wild-type"
            " complete flux is claimed. Computational expression modu"
            "les remain noncausal context. 1994/1998 full bodies rema"
            "in unavailable.",
            ["target", "original-science", "successor-science"],
        ),
        (
            "canonical",
            "grounding",
            "Original-derived full authority build",
            "All previous authority objects and source ordering are u"
            "nchanged. P76268 uses the existing earlier bulk source; "
            "its fresh scientific original and new manifest entry rem"
            "ain retained. 563 source metadata objects are the actual"
            " native output, not a forced 564 proposal.",
            ["canonical-audit"],
        ),
        (
            "representation",
            "representation",
            "Actual graph and static QA",
            acceptance["visual_summary"],
            ["page-qa", "visual-observation", "root-assessment"],
        ),
        (
            "preservation",
            "consistency",
            "Exact old corpus retention",
            "Actual preservation passed with all old records/pages/re"
            "view/history bytes and edge cells/context multiplicity r"
            "etained. No display waiver extends beyond the exact acce"
            "pted tuples.",
            ["preservation", "root-assessment"],
        ),
    ]:
        assessments.append(
            {
                "assessment_id": aid,
                "area": area,
                "topic": topic,
                "outcome": "supported",
                "summary": summary,
                "target_ids": [TARGET_ID],
                "evidence_ids": eids,
            }
        )
    review = {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "review_id": datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + "-l-lyxose-degradation",
        "kind": "record",
        "repository": "CultureBotAI/PathwayMech",
        "title": "L-lyxose degradation: maintained finalization with indep"
        "endent scientific inheritance",
        "started_at": started,
        "finished_at": now(),
        "reviewer": {
            "identity": "Codex /root/lyxose_author (packaging preparer)",
            "kind": "agent",
            "independence": "self_review",
            "independence_basis": "Authored lyxose and its bounded authority implementation"
            ". This saved record explicitly inherits the separately i"
            "ndependent original science, accepted scientific success"
            "or and canonical audit after exact target checks. It is "
            "not a new independent scientific review.",
        },
        "skill": ".claude/skills/review-yaml-record/SKILL.md",
        "completion": "completed",
        "verdict": "pass_with_limitations",
        "scientific_review": True,
        "summary": "Exact full 111-edge, 66-reference L-lyxose record retain"
        "s accepted independent science, resolved external issues"
        " 438/439, explicit source/strain/construct/conflict limi"
        "ts, original-backed canonical authorities and actual mai"
        "ntained gates/preservation/QA. No actionable finding rem"
        "ains in the accepted scope; no issue closure or merge is"
        " claimed.",
        "source": inspection["source"],
        "targets": inspection["targets"],
        "scope": {
            "description": "One complete accepted maintained pathway, all 111 edges/"
            "66 references and 10 endpoint qualifiers, with explicit "
            "inherited independent source assessment and actual packa"
            "ging receipts.",
            "selection": "Exact MetaCyc:LYXMET-PWY SHA256 " + TARGET_SHA,
            "coverage": "full",
            "population_size": 1,
            "reviewed_target_ids": [TARGET_ID],
            "exclusions": [
                {
                    "target": "Other 227 pathways",
                    "reason": "Deterministic preservation and full maintained gates; no"
                    " fresh scientific reassessment of those records.",
                }
            ],
        },
        "checks": checks,
        "evidence": evidence,
        "assessments": assessments,
        "findings": [],
        "actions": [],
        "limitations": [
            "Author-prepared self-review packaging. Full independent "
            "source assessments are inherited explicitly; no fresh al"
            "l-literature search or independent rereview is claimed.",
            "1994/1998 full originals unavailable; correct abstract/n"
            "ative annotation scope retained. iModulon context is com"
            "putational, not causal.",
            "Source exhaustion is false; public-release licensing is not resolved by this review.",
            "Native validate/save/check and scaffolded history follow"
            " this payload. Their actual receipts belong to completio"
            "n, not predeclared success in this immutable review.",
            "Commit, PR adversarial review, issue closure, CI, merge "
            "and branch cleanup remain root-owned later steps.",
        ]
        + acceptance["limitations"],
        "links": [
            "https://github.com/CultureBotAI/PathwayMech/issues/438",
            "https://github.com/CultureBotAI/PathwayMech/issues/439",
        ],
        "notes": [
            "Original independent findings and accepted dispositions "
            "remain exact external evidence. No native predecessor re"
            "view/finding IDs have been invented.",
            "Finalization artifacts added after full tests are separa"
            "tely checked and never described as having existed durin"
            "g the earlier test run.",
        ],
        "tags": [
            "pathway",
            "lyxose",
            "full-record",
            "self-review",
            "independent-inheritance",
        ],
    }
    for item in inspection["source"]["inputs"]:
        assert sha(ROOT / item["path"]) == item["sha256"], item["path"]
    (output / "completed-review.yaml").write_text(
        dump_review(review)
    )
    write(
        output / "assembly.json",
        {
            "status": "assembled_pending_native_validation_and_root_save",
            "at": now(),
            "archive_receipt": bind(args.archive_receipt),
            "config": bind(plan["config"]["path"]),
            "review": bind(output / "completed-review.yaml"),
            "inspect_receipt": bind(output / "inspect-execution.json"),
            "inspection_inputs": bind(output / "native-inspection-inputs.json"),
            "target": bind(ROOT / TARGET),
            "source_inputs": len(inspection["source"]["inputs"]),
            "review_id": review["review_id"],
            "scientific_inheritance": "explicit; preparer is original author",
            "maintained_writes": False,
        },
    )
    print(bind(output / "assembly.json"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
